# Sample recordings

## `mock_btcusd_book_2min.jsonl.gz`

**Synthetic.** Generated by the bundled mock venue (`l2tca.feed.mock_server`), not
by Kraken. It is committed so that the tests, the benchmark and any book
implementation have a deterministic, offline corpus to run against.

| | |
|---|---|
| messages | 3,155 |
| span | 125 s |
| sessions | 3 (two reconnects, each followed by a fresh snapshot) |
| frames | 3,026 book updates, 3 snapshots, 120 heartbeats, 3 status, 3 subscribe acks |
| depth | 100 |
| symbol | BTC/USD |

Regenerate it with:

```bash
uv run l2tca record --mock --duration 125 --mock-rate 25 --mock-drop-after 1200 --out data/samples
gzip -9 data/samples/mock_btcusd_*.jsonl
```

### What this sample is good for

Message shapes, sequencing, reconnect handling, the fixed-depth trim, storage
round-trips and latency benchmarking — everything that depends on the *structure*
of the feed.

### What it is not good for

* **Checksums.** The mock emits a random `uint32` in the `checksum` field, because
  computing the real CRC32 is part of the order book work this project leaves to be
  implemented by hand. A checksum implementation has to be validated against a live
  capture.
* **Anything statistical.** The mid is a random walk with a fixed tick and uniform
  sizes. Spread dynamics, size distributions, autocorrelation and the intraday
  pattern are all fictional. Do not read a microstructure result off this file.

## Capturing real data

The live venue was unreachable from the environment this project was scaffolded in
(the egress policy answered `403` to `CONNECT ws.kraken.com:443`, which the feed now
reports as a configuration error rather than retrying forever). From a machine with
open egress:

```bash
uv run l2tca record --duration 600            # ten minutes of BTC/USD, depth 100
uv run l2tca export data/raw --out data/parquet
uv run l2tca inspect --root data/parquet
```

`data/raw/` is gitignored: real captures are large and belong outside version
control. Keep a trimmed, compressed excerpt here if a committed real sample is
wanted.
